binding_constraint.name: Detect
binding_constraint.scenario: Agent A applies a materially incorrect action pattern at volume
binding_constraint.basis: Detect took 25 minutes, the longest recorded phase, before anyone acted on a 1-hour tolerance; for the exit scenario the binding constraint is gate executable_exit_for_leading_concentration, which is a Fail.

tolerance_result.clock_start_event: Onset: first materially incorrect automated action (detection followed at 25 minutes, the Detect phase)
tolerance_result.clock_stop_event: Verified human control of the queue, about 90 minutes from onset
